editorial: Autonomous agents and decision support systems have occupied a central position in the developer ecosystem today. Current projects on GitHub show that tools that increase functionality in areas such as data set management and route optimization have come to the fore.

items.title: msitarzewski/agency-agents
items.summary: The Agency-agents project offers an integrated digital agency structure consisting of specialized artificial intelligence agents with different areas of expertise. These agents, which manage processes such as software development, content production and data verification, perform tasks with certain personality traits and workflows.

items.title: usestrix/strix
items.summary: Strix is ​​an open source artificial intelligence-supported penetration testing tool developed to detect and fix security vulnerabilities in applications. Written in Python, this software aims to strengthen application defense with automated security checks.

items.title: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
items.summary: Vibe-Trading is a personal trading agent project developed for trading in financial markets. This Python-based tool aims to execute automated trading strategies by analyzing market data.

items.title: hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset
items.summary: The dataset prepared by Hasan Eyl-drm presents 433 different fitness exercises with details such as name, target muscle group, equipment and application instructions. This visual and video-supported content creates a structured data source for sports applications and training software.

items.title: facebook/astryx
items.summary: Shared by Meta, Astryx offers a design system that is fully customizable and agent ready. This TypeScript-based open source project aims to configure interface components suitable for the use of autonomous systems.

items.title: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
items.summary: OmniRoute is a free AI gateway that allows developers to access multiple AI providers such as Claude, GPT, and Gemini through a single endpoint. The tool reduces costs with the token compression method and increases the efficiency of coding assistants by offering automatic backup and multi-modal interface support.

items.title: allenai/olmocr
items.summary: Developed by AllenAI, olmocr is a toolkit that converts PDF documents into text formats suitable for large language models. This software facilitates data set preparation processes by providing linear processing of complex document structures.

items.title: logto-io/logto
items.summary: Logto offers an authentication and authorization infrastructure based on Open Authentication (OIDC) and OAuth 2.1 standards for SaaS and artificial intelligence applications. It combines features such as multi-tenancy, single sign-on (SSO) and role-based access control (RBAC) in a structure developed with TypeScript.

items.title: togatoga/karukan
items.summary: Developed with the Rust language, Karukan is a Japanese input method system (Japanese Input Method System) that uses a neural kana-kanji conversion engine for Linux and macOS operating systems. The software goes beyond traditional methods and offers an artificial intelligence-based approach to text conversion processes.

items.title: Mebus/cupp
items.summary: Common User Passwords Profiler is a Python tool for creating targeted password lists. It analyzes specified personal data and produces customized dictionaries (wordlists) that can be used in social engineering attacks.

items.title: Unclecheng-li/VulnClaw
items.summary: VulnClaw automates penetration testing processes using AI agents and the Model Context Protocol toolchain. The tool manages the information collection, vulnerability detection, exploitation and reporting stages end-to-end with natural language commands.

items.title: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
items.summary: Prepared by Microsoft, AI-For-Beginners offers a training program covering basic concepts for those who want to enter artificial intelligence with a 12-week curriculum. The content progresses through Jupyter notebooks and provides an application-oriented learning process with its 24-lesson structure.

items.title: refactoringhq/tolaria
items.summary: Tolaria is a desktop application developed for managing Markdown-based knowledge bases. Written in TypeScript, this tool offers a central interface for organizing personal documentation processes.

items.title: ogulcancelik/herdr
items.summary: Herdr is an agent multiplexer that runs on the terminal and allows managing multiple artificial intelligence agents simultaneously. This tool, developed in Rust language, allows users to interact with different agents simultaneously in the terminal environment.

items.title: 0xNyk/council-of-high-intelligence
items.summary: The Council of High Intelligence enables AI personalities working on different large language models to conduct multi-round negotiations for complex decisions. The system offers a structured discussion environment using artificial intelligence characters representing historical and scientific figures.

items.title: altic-dev/FluidVoice
items.summary: FluidVoice is a dictation application on macOS that offers on-device speech-to-text and customized AI optimization models. This tool, which works without the need for an internet connection, aims to provide high-speed text entry with local processing power.

items.title: CoreBunch/Instatic
items.summary: Instatic offers a visual content management system (visual CMS) that can be installed in a minute and hosted on your own server. Developed with TypeScript, this tool provides a user-friendly editing interface for websites.

items.title: TencentCloud/CubeSandbox
items.summary: Developed by TencentCloud in Rust, CubeSandbox offers an instant, simultaneous and secure working environment (sandbox) for artificial intelligence agents. This tool, which stands out with its lightweight structure, enables agent-based systems to operate in an isolated area.

items.title: browser-use/video-use
items.summary: The browser-use library offers a structure that allows automating video editing processes through coding agents. This Python-based tool makes visual content processing tasks manageable with programmatic commands.

items.title: yikart/AiToEarn
items.summary: The AiToEarn project offers a software infrastructure that aims to generate income from digital platforms with artificial intelligence-supported automation methods. Developed with the TypeScript language, this tool allows users to automate various tasks using artificial intelligence agents.

items.title: For first time, a cell built from scratch grows and divides
items.summary: Synthetic cells designed from scratch successfully completed the growth and division processes in a laboratory environment for the first time. This development represents a critical stage in the effort to reconstruct the basic functioning of biological systems and understand the origins of life.

items.title: ZCode – Harness for GLM-5.2
items.summary: ZCode provides a testing and evaluation framework developed for GLM-5.2 language models. This tool is used to measure the performance of large language models and standardize development processes.

items.title: FFmpeg 9.1's new AAC encoder
items.summary: FFmpeg version 9.1 includes a new advanced audio encoder (AAC encoder) that improves audio encoding quality. This update provides higher audio fidelity and efficient compression performance, especially at low bit rates.

items.title: Show HN: Searchable directory of 22k+ products from worker-owned co-ops
items.summary: Listing more than 22 thousand products produced by worker-owned co-ops, the directory allows users to reach these businesses directly. The platform offers an alternative marketplace experience by increasing the discoverability of cooperative-oriented products.

items.title: What to learn to be a graphics programmer
items.summary: For those who want to become a graphics programmer, core competencies such as mathematical foundations, hardware architecture and graphics application interfaces (graphics APIs) stand out. This roadmap offers a comprehensive learning curve for those who want to learn low-level systems programming and visualization techniques.

items.title: baidu/Unlimited-OCR
items.summary: Developed by Baidu, Unlimited-OCR is an image-to-text model that processes visual texts and produces text output. The system aims to automate the process of converting data from complex documents into digital format.

items.title: empero-ai/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M-GGUF
items.summary: Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M model is a multimodal artificial intelligence model that produces text output by processing visual and text-based data. The model offers the ability to analyze complex data sets with wide context window support.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.2
items.summary: GLM-5.2, developed by Zai-org, is a language model optimized for text generation tasks. The highly interactive model on the Hugging Face platform offers the capacity to create text in natural language processing processes.

items.title: deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-35B-GGUF
items.summary: Ornith-1.0-35B, published by DeepReinforce-AI, is a language model optimized for text generation tasks. The model is provided with weights compressed in GGUF format so that it can be run on local devices.

items.title: deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-9B-GGUF
items.summary: Ornith-1.0-9B-GGUF, developed by DeepReinforce-AI, is a language model focused on text generation. The model is presented in compressed GGUF format in order to use hardware resources efficiently.
